name: Mission 4 C1 joint N-node fusion smoke comparison

acceptance.reference: legacy config on same exact site/seed/profile jobs
acceptance.rule: docs/round2-method.md rule four and Mission 4 acceptance rule; validation is accept/reject only

known_scope: This smoke covers the preregistered stationary one-source smoke cells only.
C1 does not change rendering, legacy mode, or default solver.
Joint mode handles static tracks only; moving tracks retain legacy pairwise behavior until separately implemented and accepted.
All thresholds and covariance-derived radii are placeholders pending independent calibration.

Implementation reuses round-2 weighted consensus for RANSAC inlier selection and exact disjoint-track assignment; unlike the rejected pair-proposal trial, C1 fits all compatible node bearings jointly with a final Huber loss and returns the fit covariance.
